hints: For each right endpoint, find the earliest left endpoint that keeps all values distinct.
Maintain last-seen positions; when value x repeats inside the window, move left past its previous position.
The number of valid subarrays ending at right is right-left+1.
analogy: A sliding window grows until a repeated value forces its left edge past the earlier copy.
example: For 1,2,1,3, at the final 3 the unique suffix is 2,1,3, adding three valid subarrays.
algorithm: Track last positions and a left boundary. For each index i, update left=max(left,last[a[i]]+1), add i-left+1, and store last[a[i]]=i.
correctness: Every valid subarray ending at i starts at or after left, and every such start works; counting these contributions counts each distinct-value subarray once.
complexity: O(n) expected time and O(n) space.
